note: Both sets contain invented or misbound claims, but Set B is somewhat cleaner: it correctly ties the 2'-4" FIRST FLR elevation to grade level, captures the C1 scale (6" = 1'-0"), and correctly reads the 2" X 8" frame/joist and 3/8" X 4" hex through bolt. Set A invents several values and quotes outright (4.5" bolt, 2" x 6" x 12" TREATED WOOD SURFACE, 3" HEX THROUGH-BOLT, 1" SLEEVE, 2'-0") and misattributes A6 dimensions (1 1/4", 8'-0") and B1 dimensions (7 1/2") to other details. Set B also errs (5/4 x 6 x 12 PRESSURE TREATED, 1'-6", 2" x 4" FRAMING, 8" FRAME, unsupported sleeve/threaded-rod 'connection' claims, and misbinding COMMON WOOD NAILS OR SCREWS and 3 3/4"), but with fewer total failures and better kept conditions.
